items.text: Radwater now deals significant damage to full kits and uses a new scaling system that reduces rad amounts via scaled protection rather than flat values.
Flashlight toggles on/off with right‑click like a torch; updated animations, sounds, tooltips, and it extinguishes on sleep or disconnect.
Semi‑automatic pistol gains increased damage falloff at range and its high‑quality material crafting cost raised from 4 to 6.
Adjusted loot spawn chances: SMG bodies spawn more frequently while Rifle bodies spawn less, improving mid‑game weapon balance.
Bear rug and rug comfort values raised to 100 % within 2 m/1 m respectively (gradual falloff thereafter), fixing the previous 25 % solo comfort issue.
Low‑resolution navmesh on ghost ships fixed, improving AI pathing on those vessels.
Old AI units no longer flee when the player jumps, correcting errant escape behavior.
Modular car handling improved: reduced body roll, prevented spin‑outs, and smoothed steering for higher‑speed drifting.
Mirrored wheel models on modular cars corrected by fixing wheel mesh assignments and clearing leftover rotations.
HAB vehicle armor colliders set up correctly for client and server, with an added collision mesh for the frame.
Attack helicopter armor collider groups renamed and toggled properly, ensuring unique inspector entries and correct removal.
Rabbit assets (animation, model, prefabs) added and standardized naming, enabling rabbits in the game world.
Basic squirrel critter added to the game.
New UI panels for selling animals: a list of nearby sellable animals and a preview showing expected rewards, plus in‑game display of livestock sale information.
Session modal overflow fixed: description scroll works and flex elements are clamped, preventing the disconnect button from being hidden.
Store UI updated to support DynamicFullscreenSprite, DynamicGallerySprite, DynamicPagePrefab fields and default picker rendering, with layout and inspector fixes.
SteamFriendsList.Refresh optimized, eliminating large lag spikes when authorizing friends to turrets or other team objects.
Hackable crates now correctly flagged with visual fixes; puzzlereset alerts are skipped when a forced reset occurs after a restart.
Cargo ship event now correctly saves crate locations and loot rounds across server restarts, preventing crates from despawning and avoiding overlapping spawns.

2026-08-25.summary:
### Combat & Weapon Balance
- Radwater now deals significant damage to full kits and uses a new scaling system that reduces rad amounts via scaled protection rather than flat values.
- Flashlight toggles on/off with right‑click like a torch; updated animations, sounds, tooltips, and it extinguishes on sleep or disconnect.
- Semi‑automatic pistol gains increased damage falloff at range and its high‑quality material crafting cost raised from 4 to 6.
- Adjusted loot spawn chances: SMG bodies spawn more frequently while Rifle bodies spawn less, improving mid‑game weapon balance.

### Comfort & Environment
- Bear rug and rug comfort values raised to 100 % within 2 m/1 m respectively (gradual falloff thereafter), fixing the previous 25 % solo comfort issue.

### AI & Navigation
- Low‑resolution navmesh on ghost ships fixed, improving AI pathing on those vessels.
- Old AI units no longer flee when the player jumps, correcting errant escape behavior.

### Vehicles & Armor
- Modular car handling improved: reduced body roll, prevented spin‑outs, and smoothed steering for higher‑speed drifting.
- Mirrored wheel models on modular cars corrected by fixing wheel mesh assignments and clearing leftover rotations.
- HAB vehicle armor colliders set up correctly for client and server, with an added collision mesh for the frame.
- Attack helicopter armor collider groups renamed and toggled properly, ensuring unique inspector entries and correct removal.

### Animals, Livestock & Critters
- Rabbit assets (animation, model, prefabs) added and standardized naming, enabling rabbits in the game world.
- Basic squirrel critter added to the game.
- New UI panels for selling animals: a list of nearby sellable animals and a preview showing expected rewards, plus in‑game display of livestock sale information.

### UI, Session & Performance
- Session modal overflow fixed: description scroll works and flex elements are clamped, preventing the disconnect button from being hidden.
- Store UI updated to support DynamicFullscreenSprite, DynamicGallerySprite, DynamicPagePrefab fields and default picker rendering, with layout and inspector fixes.
- SteamFriendsList.Refresh optimized, eliminating large lag spikes when authorizing friends to turrets or other team objects.
- Hackable crates now correctly flagged with visual fixes; puzzlereset alerts are skipped when a forced reset occurs after a restart.
- Cargo ship event now correctly saves crate locations and loot rounds across server restarts, preventing crates from despawning and avoiding overlapping spawns.
